title: Bound #4470's complex row coefficient within 5/4 (no new κ)
body:
PR #4972 left a coarse bracket for the selected complex stock coefficient. This adds a written two-sided bound for the actual #4470 product/completion/splitting rule under **#4436's nested divisible-width realization**, without changing the supplier or compiler.

For `H = 64215200000000`, `N = 2^H` and `K = ceil(log2 B_N)/H`:

```text
2.943 N < K < 3.639 N
```

The endpoint ratio is below **5/4**. The proof counts distinct root sources, bounds height using the actual productive floor, and charges all original paid calls, split rounding and completion calls. This bounds one permitted realization; it does not identify a minimal or uniquely selected width.

In #4972's **same conditional outer accounting**, retaining `c_row = 1`, `Cw = 232960`, BIT/old-stock tariffs, nesting and sum allowances, the sufficient `log2 C` upper bound falls from **64215200000024 to 64215200000010**; the displayed fit bound becomes `log2 p = 64473100659036`. The factor-5/4 bracket concerns K, not optimal C. The fit deliberately retains the predecessor's stricter `beta = 69999991/70000000`; selected #4470 uses `1399999997/1400000000`, so this is a conservative formula comparison. **No new κ:** the accepted conditional exponent stays `60403/20000000`.

## Validation

Linux x86_64, CPython **3.12.15**, standard library only:

```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/selected-complex-width-envelope
python3.12 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/selected-complex-width-envelope
python3.12 -B scripts/export_research_package.py export --package research/selected-complex-width-envelope --output /tmp/complex-width-envelope.tar
python3.12 -B scripts/export_research_package.py check /tmp/complex-width-envelope.tar
```

Both registered normal/optimized commands pass: 366 small source flows, 12 literal comparisons, 332 nested lower checks, 16 height checks, 12 exact product/pad/split cases, six reduced-power (`v=1`) calibrations of the actual #4470 invoice, and five mathematical rejection controls.

Committed-byte and official export checks pass for all 18 declared files. Git-free direct normal/optimized replay passes with read-only file modes and Git absent from PATH. Six private mutations each reject in both modes: omitted completion, unqualified floor credit, wrong height rounding, changed source bytes, changed receipt and missing source. Code mutations use `--emit` so failure is mathematical rather than a stale-receipt mismatch. All 19 exported files including the export receipt remain byte-identical.

Export SHA-256: `2f85c372b5cea6193b0b9a48159474f223b336d5df13e7bb4d0f1251050762b0`.

Evidence is **author-checked**. No independent human review or proof-kernel acceptance is claimed. [Hosted plan and the sole registered-package replay](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/39913441499) both passed at the exact publication head. Hosted execution corroborates this bounded author verifier, not independent scientific acceptance.

## Limits and credit

Not checked: exact B_N, alternative/minimal batching, a materialized native/all-column program, owned-bank/route bodies, precision/fixed tapes, BIT/outer admission, analytic/prime/recovery premises, or the selected cold replay. The optional full-history ancestry preflight was not run in the shallow clone; direct export needs no Git or foreign source objects.
